visualCharacteristics.purpose: rotating full-width promotional slides, each a photo with an overlapping content box
visualCharacteristics.description: Full-width 3-slide carousel; each slide is a photo with a white content box overlapping its bottom-left (h2, description, yellow CTA); dot indicators and prev/next arrows.

contentPattern.structure: cell 1 image; cell 2 heading, description and CTA link

usage: Top-of-page hero carousel with two or more promotional slides.
reuseGuidance: Use for any rotating hero with image + boxed text/CTA per slide. For a single static slide use hero-boxed.
